title: My Health Buddy UI flow updates (Luma rename, Start-first menu, location step, grown-ups lock)

requirements.summary: Rename helper character to Luma everywhere and update the welcome greeting to the exact requested sentence.
acceptanceCriteria: No screen shows the name “Amanda”.
Welcome greeting text matches exactly: “Hi, I’m Luma. I help you show how you feel.”

file_operations.description: Update all helper naming references to “Luma” and replace the greeting copy with exactly: “Hi, I’m Luma. I help you show how you feel.” Keep the screen minimal per the new launch flow. Uses shadcn-ui Button for the Start action; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Audit and update any helper-name references in this screen’s UI strings to ensure “Amanda” does not appear anywhere. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Audit and update any helper-name references in this screen’s UI strings to ensure “Amanda” does not appear anywhere. Uses shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Replace the two specified longer supportive sentences with the specified short phrases wherever they appear.
acceptanceCriteria: The helper message on the feeling confirmation screen uses “Let’s tell a grown-up”.
The encouragement shown on the adult message flow uses exactly: “You did the right thing 💛”.
No remaining UI text contains the two long sentences provided in the request.

file_operations.description: Replace the helper message text with exactly “Let’s tell a grown-up” (and ensure the longer sentence no longer appears). Uses shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace the delayed encouragement copy with exactly: “You did the right thing 💛” and remove the two longer sentences so they no longer appear anywhere on this flow. Uses shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make the first screen logo + Luma + one large Start button; move all other options to a new menu screen shown after Start.
acceptanceCriteria: On app launch (after splash), the user sees only the logo, the Luma character, and a single large “Start” button (no other menu buttons).
Pressing “Start” navigates to a new menu screen that contains the previously available options (e.g., feelings, energy check, daily feelings, feel better, and grown-ups access).
The overall navigation still allows reaching all existing features from the new post-Start menu screen.

file_operations.description: Simplify the launch screen content to only show the logo (from ScreenLayout), the Luma character image, and a single large “Start” button. Remove the other menu buttons, grown-ups access UI, and disclaimer from this screen. Uses shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a post-Start menu screen that lists the previous options (feelings, my energy today, daily feelings, feel better) and provides access to the grown-ups lock flow. Use shadcn-ui Button (and Card if needed) to keep a consistent child-friendly layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add and wire a new 'menu' screen into the in-app navigation state machine: Splash -> Welcome; Welcome Start -> Menu; update existing routes so Back actions return to Menu where appropriate while preserving reachability of all features.

requirements.summary: Make “Show this to an adult” the largest and most visually prominent button in the app, centered on its screen.
acceptanceCriteria: On the feeling confirmation screen, “Show this to an adult” is centered and visually dominant compared to any other button in the app (larger size and stronger emphasis styling).
No other screen contains a button that is larger or more visually emphasized than “Show this to an adult”.

file_operations.description: Center the “Show this to an adult” button and update sizing/emphasis so it is the single most visually dominant button in the app (larger height/width, stronger emphasis styling). Use shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust the Welcome “Start” button styling so it remains large and easy to tap but is still clearly smaller/less emphasized than the “Show this to an adult” button. Uses shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Reduce visual dominance of the energy option buttons (currently very large) so none can be considered larger/more emphasized than “Show this to an adult”. Keep them child-friendly and tappable. Uses shadcn-ui Button for Back; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Remove scrolling on the feelings selection page by resizing and evenly laying out feeling cards so all options are visible at once.
acceptanceCriteria: The feelings page shows all feeling options without requiring vertical scrolling on common mobile viewport sizes.
All feeling option cards are evenly sized and presented in a consistent grid.

file_operations.description: Rework the feelings grid layout to fit all feeling cards on one screen without vertical scrolling on common mobile sizes: reduce padding/icon sizes as needed, ensure consistent card sizing, and keep a clean grid. Use shadcn-ui Card for the feeling options and shadcn-ui Button for Back; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

If needed to meet no-scroll requirements, add a layout option (prop or class behavior) to better allocate vertical space for grid-heavy screens while keeping the overall calm style consistent. Ensure this change does not introduce scrolling regressions on other screens.

requirements.summary: Insert a new location screen after the main help button that asks “Where are you?” with exactly three large location buttons.
acceptanceCriteria: Pressing “Show this to an adult” navigates to a new location screen instead of directly to the adult message screen.
The location screen displays the question exactly: “Where are you?”.
The location screen provides exactly three buttons: “At school”, “At home”, “Outside”.
Selecting any location proceeds to the existing adult message screen flow.

file_operations.description: Create a new screen that asks exactly “Where are you?” and shows exactly three large buttons: “At school”, “At home”, “Outside”. Selecting any option continues to the existing adult message flow. Use shadcn-ui Button for the three large choices; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add and wire a new 'location' screen into navigation. Update the post-confirmation flow so the Feeling Confirmation 'continue' action goes to Location first, then Location selection proceeds to the existing adult message screen.

Update the continue handler wiring so “Show this to an adult” navigates to the new Location screen rather than directly to the adult message flow. Uses shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make “Grown-ups only” a working button that opens a dedicated lock flow: 3-second star hold (when supported) then a math question; wrong answer shows exact error; correct answer opens settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping “Grown-ups only” opens a dedicated lock UI (not immediate navigation into settings).
When press-and-hold is supported, the lock UI requires a continuous 3-second hold on a star before showing the math question.
When press-and-hold is not supported, the lock UI directly shows the math question without requiring hold.
Submitting a wrong math answer shows exactly: “Try again, grown-ups only” (and does not grant access).
Submitting the correct math answer grants access and navigates to the grown-ups settings area page.

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated full-screen lock UI for grown-ups access. Implement a 3-second press-and-hold star step when supported, otherwise skip directly to a simple math question. On wrong answer, show exactly “Try again, grown-ups only” inline in the UI; on correct answer, navigate to the grown-ups settings area. Use shadcn-ui Button and Input for the math challenge UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a real, accessible “Grown-ups only” button in the post-Start menu that navigates to the new dedicated lock UI (do not navigate directly to settings). Uses shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add and wire a new 'grownups-lock' screen into the in-app navigation state machine and ensure success navigates to the existing grown-ups area page while Back returns to the menu.

Refactor the existing gating component so it no longer acts as an inline dialog gate on the welcome screen. Either repurpose it for the lock screen’s star-hold/math logic or convert it into a simple trigger UI used by MenuPage to open the dedicated lock screen. Ensure wrong-answer messaging matches exactly “Try again, grown-ups only” when used. Uses shadcn-ui Dialog/Input/Button if retained; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Remove grown-ups access UI from the first screen to comply with the new Start-first flow (grown-ups access must live on the post-Start menu and open the dedicated lock screen). Uses shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Keep all updated/new screens calm, simple, child-friendly, and in short easy English.
acceptanceCriteria: All new/modified UI strings are short, supportive, and in English.
No new screen introduces dense paragraphs or complex instructions beyond what is necessary for the lock flow.

file_operations.description: Review and adjust menu labels so they remain short, clear, and child-friendly while still matching existing feature names. Uses shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the question and button labels are exactly as requested and keep any supporting text minimal and child-friendly. Uses shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the lock flow instructions are minimal and clear, avoiding dense text; keep the exact wrong-answer message. Uses shadcn-ui Button/Input; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the updated encouragement copy is short and supportive (“You did the right thing 💛”) and no additional dense text is introduced. Uses shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
